2608.23030.title: Artificial Empathy: Towards a Framework for Unsupervised Agency Detection and Policy Reconstruction
2608.23030.paper_summary: We study how an AI system can identify and model other agents in its environment from observation alone, which is a capability necessary for cooperative behaviour in the real world. This problem is less constrained than inverse reinforcement learning and remains largely unexplored. We propose a framework that uses a reinforcement learning agent, trained on an independent task as a prior about agentic dynamics, to perform agency detection and policy reconstruction.
2608.23030.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究一個AI系統如何僅透過觀察來識別和建模其環境中的其他代理，這是實現現實世界中合作行為所需的能力。這個問題的約束性低於逆強化學習，且仍然在很大程度上未被探索。我們提出一個框架，利用在獨立任務上訓練的強化學習代理作為對代理動態的先驗知識，來進行代理檢測和政策重建。
